node: Grid transmission hardware and tower-line components
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around transmission hardware and tower-line components. The strongest underfollowed direct candidate is PLPC, which maps to engineered line hardware, fittings, insulators, spacer dampers, and utility inspection services. Adjacent structural-component suppliers ACA and VMI map to utility poles, lattice/tubular structures, and grid-hardening infrastructure. HUBB is included as a reference leader because its Utility Solutions segment has direct T&D components exposure but the company is larger and more diversified. This is research support only, not a trading recommendation.
